scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera: open Aegean sea, and the island exactly as shown, low and far off on the horizon, with its mountain, Hellenistic Greece. Calm dawn after a storm: cloud breaking up, pale early light, a gentle swell. In the middle distance at right, a tall narrow stack of pale rock rises sheer from the sea, alone. In its lee lie six merchant ships exactly like the ship of [image 2], at anchor, sails brailed up, spread out on the water, a few small sailors on their decks. Deep focus, all sharp. No warships, no rams, no other land, nothing modern.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms: the stone quay of a small harbour with a colonnaded customs house, Hellenistic Greece. Replace every placeholder shape with real stone and tile. A winter gale: dark driving cloud, grey light, rain in the wind, waves breaking over the harbour mole and spray flying. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its man and objects exactly. Along the quay at right, two merchant ships like the board's ship lie moored, sails furled, held by thick ropes to stone bollards like the board's, straining. In the foreground the heavy-set grey-haired man in the brown sea-cloak stands braced against the wind, holding up to the light the board's tall bottle-shaped glass flask of golden olive oil, reading it; not a round flask, no red liquid. Deep focus, all sharp. No other people. Nothing modern.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera and composition: the stone quay and harbour mole of a small port, open sea beyond, Hellenistic Greece. Replace every placeholder shape with real stone, rope and timber. The winter storm is breaking: dark cloud pulling away, shafts of low sun on the sea, the swell easing. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its three people and ship exactly. In the foreground on the quay the three people of the board stand together watching the sea: the woman in the rust-red peplos with a wax tablet at her belt, the young woman with the auburn braid and dark green cloak, and the heavy-set grey-haired man in the brown sea-cloak. Beyond the mole, merchant ships like the board's ship sail out together in one line, square sails full, toward the horizon; the two ships at the quay cast off to follow, sailors hauling ropes. No warships, no rams. Deep focus, all sharp. Nothing modern.
